// CASE dup_plain expect=fire
export async function dup_plain<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<number>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      merge(await operation(items[index]), await operation(items[index]));
    }
  }));
}
// CASE dup_comment_only expect=fire
export async function dup_comment_only<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<number>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      merge(await operation(items[index]) /* it's */, await operation(items[index]));
    }
  }));
}
// CASE dup_comment_and_string expect=fire
export async function dup_comment_and_string<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<number>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      merge(await operation(items[index]) /* it's */, await operation(items[index]), 'x');
    }
  }));
}
// CASE dup_two_strings expect=fire
export async function dup_two_strings<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<number>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      merge(await operation(items[index]), 'a', await operation(items[index]), 'b');
    }
  }));
}
// CASE dup_dq_strings expect=fire
export async function dup_dq_strings<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<number>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      merge(await operation(items[index]), "it's", await operation(items[index]), "x");
    }
  }));
}
// CASE extra_two_strings expect=fire
export async function extra_two_strings<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<number>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      merge(await operation(items[index]), 'a', await audit(items[index]), 'b');
    }
  }));
}
